data.name: Hiram
data.gender_notes: Hiram is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Hiram is recorded in name-lists as “Mountain of love”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hiram expresses “Mountain of love”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hiram total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_latin.name: Hiram
in_latin.meaning: nomen gentilicium, nomen virile, nomen a Hebraeo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Hiram significat virum sapientem, virum prudentem, virum industriosum. A Hebraeo originatur, nam Hiram fuit rex Tyri. In Ecclesiis Christianis, nomen Hiram significat virum virtutum, qui Deo servit et hominibus bonos est.
